content:
Docker Registry to use for storing function Docker images.
Enums
DOCKER_REGISTRY_UNSPE
CIFIED
Unspecified.
CONTAINER_REGISTRY
Docker images will be stored in multi-regional Container Registry repositories named
gcf.
ARTIFACT_REGISTRY
Docker images will be stored in regional Artifact Registry repositories. By default, GCF
will create and use repositories named gcf-artifacts in every region in which a
function is deployed. But the repository to use can also be specified by the user using
the dockerRepository field.
